svg.title: Materials engineer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as materials engineer, wearing a protective coat and protective goggles. Visible work cue: A pointed testing indenter is clearly separated from a layered material specimen below it. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: protective goggles.
